_about: Business Model Canvas settings. Osterwalder's nine blocks. Labels, helper text and the typical-practice lines are editable here with no code change. Template lines are marked 'typical' in the app; lines taken from Tereflow's own trade data are marked 'from data'. Placeholders: {product} {country} {buyers} {suppliers} {iso3}.

help.en: Who you sell to. In trade: the importing countries, and the kind of buyer (distributor, processor, retailer).
Why a buyer picks you: price, quality, reliability, origin, certification.
How the goods and the offer reach the buyer: direct sale, agents, trade fairs, platforms, freight route.
How you keep buyers: samples, contracts, regular contact, after-sales handling of claims.
How money comes in: price per tonne or unit, volume, payment terms.
What you need to have: supply, working capital, storage, licences, staff.
What you must do: source, grade, pack, document, ship, collect payment.
Who you depend on: suppliers, forwarders, customs brokers, inspectors, banks.
What it costs: goods, freight, insurance, duties, finance, certification, currency risk.
